# Reader report — HARD samples (generated by `node reader/eval.mjs --hard`, models `claude claude-sonnet-5-5 + claude-opus-5-5`)

Scored on 4 faded thermal receipts and 4 hand-written cash-book pages in `samples/hard/` (made by `samples/make_hard_samples.py`). Hand-writing is simulated with hand-lettering fonts, so real cash books will vary more.

Legend: ✓ = reader called it "read" (two readings agree and the bill's own sums fit); ? = reader said "check this"; ✗ after it = the figure was wrong.

| bill | photo | layout | total | subtotal | vat | date_bs | bill_no | pan | vendor | method | head | kind |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| fth01 | phone, faded 55% | thermal | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ? | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ |
| fth02 | phone, faded 40% | thermal | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ |
| fth03 | phone, faded 45% | thermal | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ? | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ |
| fth04 | poor, faded 28% | thermal | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ? | ✓ | ✓ |

## Per field

| field | read & right | read but WRONG | check (was right) | check (was wrong) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| total | 4 | **0** | 0 | 0 |
| subtotal | 4 | **0** | 0 | 0 |
| vat | 2 | **0** | 2 | 0 |
| date_bs | 0 | **0** | 4 | 0 |
| bill_no | 4 | **0** | 0 | 0 |
| pan | 4 | **0** | 0 | 0 |
| vendor | 4 | **0** | 0 | 0 |
| method | 0 | **0** | 4 | 0 |

"read but WRONG" is the number to drive to zero: a figure the app shows as read although it is not right. The person still confirms every entry, but they should never be lulled by a tick.
